data.one_liner: SDK for barcode scanning, document scanning, and MRZ scanning applications.
data.what_it_does: The Dynamsoft Capture Vision Flutter SDK provides a wrapper for building barcode reading, label recognition, document board detection, and text recognition applications. It integrates image source adapters, result receivers, and camera enhancers to deliver enterprise-grade performance.
use_when: You need robust enterprise-grade barcode scanning or document scanning in your Flutter app.
You require advanced capabilities like multi-threaded barcode decoding or data matrix color inversion detection.
avoid_when: You only need a basic open-source QR code scanner and want to avoid proprietary licenses or paid SDKs.
You do not want to configure platform-specific camera permissions and initial license setups.
strengths: Multi-threaded barcode decoding for faster results
Comprehensive suite covering barcode, document, and text recognition
weaknesses: Requires a paid license/trial key to function
Platform-specific configuration required for Android and iOS
data.setup_notes: Requires setting camera permissions in Android code and iOS Info.plist, and initializing an SDK license key on app startup.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a popular, lightweight open-source barcode scanner without commercial license requirements.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer leveraging Google's on-device ML Kit for barcode scanning.
